item.title: 【HD Live Performances】UHDTV 4K - Justin Bieber - LIVE FROM COACHELLA [Weekend I] (2160p 4K)
item.description:
Justin Bieber - LIVE FROM COACHELLA [Weekend I] (2160p 4K)​


​
Coachella (officially called the Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival) is an annual music and arts festival held at the Empire Polo Club in Indio, California. On April 15, 2025, it was confirmed that Justin Bieber would be the headliner of April 11 and 18, 2026. Rolling Stone has exclusively confirmed that Justin Bieber secured a seven-figure deal. Bieber negotiated directly with promoter Goldenvoice, as Justin is currently without a manager; he now works with his own team; The Bieber Family Office. The deal exceeded $10 million for the two-weekend event ($5 million per concert). On June 26, 2026, Justin released the live album titled 'SWAG LIVE FROM COACHELLA (Weekend I)' on streaming platforms and re-broadcasted the entire set for fans to enjoy.





















More information: https://www.universalmusic.ca/press...ive-album-swag-live-from-coachella-weekend-i/
